summary: Launch Two Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a working capital promissory note from its sponsor, Launch Two Sponsor, LLC. The sponsor loaned $848,000, with $750,000 cash proceeds advanced August 7, 2026; the note bears 8% annual interest, has a 10% prepayment penalty, and matures on the earlier of a business combination, winding up, or six-month anniversary, with possible extensions. This is routine SPAC working-capital financing, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event; watch for future business combination announcement.
